info.name: Sales Online API v1
info.description:
REST API of the Sales Online e-commerce engine.

Select the **Sales Online - local** environment. Requests use HTTP Basic as `{{username}}` unless a folder or request says otherwise. The server uses a self-signed certificate, so SSL verification is off per request.

Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner: later requests reuse ids (`productId`, `orderId`, `categoryId`) that earlier ones store in collection variables.

item.name: Health and docs
item.description: Public endpoints outside the versioned API.

item.name: Auth and profile
item.description: Registration (public) and the profile of the signed-in user.

request.description: Filters: `category` (slug), `tag` (repeatable; any, or all with `matchAll=true`), `attr=key:value` (jsonb containment). Sort: NAME, PRICE, PRICE_DESC, RATING, NEWEST.

item.name: Search and AI
item.description: Search is public; AI questions need a signed-in user and an OpenAI key on the server.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Placing and cancelling are asynchronous (Kafka): they answer 202 and the order status changes shortly after.

request.description: The body is optional; without `shippingAddress` the default address of the profile is used.

item.name: Errors
item.description: Every error is an RFC 9457 problem response with a correlationId.

item.name: OAuth2
item.description: Bearer JWT from the OAuth2 broker (https://localhost:8443). Put an access token in the `accessToken` environment variable. A token user is provisioned on first use; `ADMIN` in the token's `scope` grants the admin role.
